'''Mad Anghus's Fun Public House''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] during the earliest [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. One of the regular patrons, an aged former [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], told stories of the viciousness of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] he had encountered on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
